 Fake Army Captain Caught At Varanasi Air Show | Arpit Chaturvedi Arrested
 Fake captain caught at Varanasi air show: IB, Air Force question him; police file FIR and send him to jail
 Varanasi 4 hours ago 
 Copy link 
 A fake captain was caught in the helipad area of Namo Ghat in Varanasi ahead of an air show. He was roaming in the restricted area while claiming to be an Army captain. Security personnel caught him after becoming suspicious.
 His posting as a captain in the Army could not be confirmed, after which he was handed over to the police. The युवक was identified as Arpit Chaturvedi. Intelligence agencies questioned him for hours. The police registered a named FIR against him.
 Roaming in highly sensitive helipad area 
 Security arrangements had been tightened in Varanasi in view of the Air Force air show scheduled for Sunday. Despite this, a युवक reached the restricted area of the helipad at Namo Ghat on Saturday.
 The personnel deployed on duty found his activities suspicious. During questioning, he claimed to be an Army captain. His answers and demeanour increased the personnel's suspicion. The authorities and local police were subsequently informed.
 After receiving the information, police and administrative officials, along with officers from the Intelligence Bureau (IB), the Local Intelligence Unit (LIU) and the Air Force, reached the spot. The youth was taken into custody and questioning began.
 No evidence of posting as captain found in army records 
 Given the sensitivity of the matter, the youth was taken to the office of a senior officer of the Varanasi Police Commissionerate. There, intelligence units of the IB, LIU and Air Force questioned him for several hours.
 During the initial questioning, he identified himself as Captain Arpit. He gave his address as being near the PWD Colony in Jadid Bazar, under the jurisdiction of Cantt police station. However, checks of Army records and the address he provided did not confirm that he was a captain.
 After the investigation, he was identified as Arpit Chaturvedi. According to officials, he is originally from Varanasi's Nadesar area.
 Father runs a pathology centre 
 According to the DCP of Kashi, Arpit's father runs a pathology centre in the city. An investigation is under way into why the young man claimed to be an army officer and how he reached the restricted helipad area. Security and intelligence agencies are also gathering information related to the case.
 A named FIR has been registered against Arpit Chaturvedi at Adampur police station on the complaint of Chandan Kumar, in-charge of the Namoghat police outpost. The police have taken action against him and filed a charge sheet.
